summary: A small full-stack project tracker with a browser UI, Node.js API, and durable file-backed storage.

questions.question: Which language should the project use?

options.label: JavaScript
options.description: Node.js with browser JavaScript

questions.question: Which language should the browser UI use?

options.label: JavaScript
options.description: Browser JavaScript

questions.question: What should the browser UI do?
questions.answer: Create and list projects through accessible controls.
questions.recommendedChoice: Create and list projects through accessible controls.

questions.question: What should the project tracker do?
questions.answer: Create and list projects through an accessible browser UI.
questions.recommendedChoice: Create and list projects through an accessible browser UI.

questions.question: Which data stores does the app need?

options.label: No datastore required
options.description: No persistent data

options.label: File storage
options.description: Durable local JSON file

questions.question: Does this app need user login?

options.label: No
options.description: No user sign-in or authenticated API access

questions.question: How will this app be used?
questions.rationale: This is a local certification fixture, not a production workload.

options.label: Development / Demo
options.description: A prototype, proof of concept, or temporary demonstration

options.label: Standard Production
options.description: A production app with normal business availability expectations

options.label: Business-Critical
options.description: An app whose outage or data loss would materially disrupt the business

questions.question: What is the most sensitive data this app will handle?
questions.rationale: The fixture stores only synthetic project names.

options.label: Public
options.description: Information intended for public access

options.label: Internal
options.description: Business information intended only for the organization

options.label: Confidential / Personal
options.description: Private, personal, or commercially sensitive information

options.label: Regulated
options.description: Data subject to a legal, industry, or contractual compliance regime

questions.question: What usage pattern should the app support?
questions.rationale: The fixture is exercised by a small deterministic test.

options.label: Small / Steady
options.description: Low to moderate traffic without large spikes

options.label: Bursty
options.description: Occasional sharp traffic spikes or event-driven work

options.label: High Volume
options.description: Sustained high request, event, or data volume

options.label: Latency Sensitive
options.description: Interactive operations with strict response-time expectations

questions.question: What should architecture tradeoffs prioritize?
questions.rationale: The fixture has no production tradeoff preference.

options.label: Balanced
options.description: Balance cost, reliability, operability, and performance

options.label: Lowest Cost
options.description: Prefer the lowest practical operating cost and accept documented tradeoffs

options.label: Highest Reliability
options.description: Prefer availability and recoverability over lower cost

options.label: Lowest Latency
options.description: Prefer interactive performance over lower cost
